title: Production Context
description: OEE 1.0 production-context document from a governed REST interface. MES remains System of Record. Optional fields are not required to calculate OEE.

contextId.description: Idempotent identity of this context document.

orderId.description: Optional production order. Required only when windowKind is order.

idealCycleTimeSeconds.description: Seconds per unit. Source of Performance ideal cycle time.

targetQuantity.description: Context only. Not used in OEE 1.0 formulas.

timestamp.description: Event time of this context document (when the plan was issued or last updated).

shiftId.description: Optional shift label. Does not imply a platform shift calendar.

productId.description: Optional product identity. Alias of materialId when the context source uses that name.

plannedDowntime.description: Scheduled downtime intervals. Reduces planned production time. Not a STOPPED machine state. Type CHANGEOVER is informational only.

type.description: Informational planned-downtime class such as CHANGEOVER. Does not introduce a separate SMED formula.
